ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA open-ended question - reason 1
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: According to the disclosure by the Anhui Provincial Cooperation and Exchange Office on July 6, 2012, affected by downward pressure on economic operation, the growth rate of Anhui's use of investment from other provinces declined somewhat, but it was still an outstanding performer nationwide in undertaking industrial transfer, and the number of major industrial projects introduced by the province increased noticeably. Read the following figure and answer the question. <image1> In which cost advantages is one main reason that Anhui Province became an outstanding performer nationwide in undertaking industrial transfer reflected?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: Land costs, energy costs, and labor costs are relatively low

method.model_answer: 土地成本、能源成本、劳动力成本较低。
